Meet PlanStudy.

From a course-outline PDF to a finished study day — the whole app, start to finish, in under a minute.

Sound familiar?

Most students plan on scraps of paper. Until it fails.

A timetable in a notebook is easy to lose, hard to change and never reminds you of anything.

The timetable you lost

It was in the back of a notebook. Now you cannot remember which lecture hall you should be in, or when.

The deadline that crept up

The assignment was due weeks away, then suddenly it was due tomorrow, and nothing was planned.

The exam you started too late

Five subjects, one week, no plan. Without a daily schedule, revision turns into panic.

How it works

Four steps, all on your phone.

No printing, no rewriting, no spreadsheets.

Add your subjects

List what you are studying this semester.

Build your timetable

Add your classes, times and colours. Change them whenever your week changes.

Tell PlanStudy what is due and when.

Follow your daily plan

Get a day-by-day plan you can actually finish, one day at a time.

Everything in one app

Start with your timetable. Grow from there.

PlanStudy does more than timetable blocks — the timetable is simply where every week begins, so that is what we build first.

An AI day-by-day plan

Tell PlanStudy your subjects and deadlines. It turns them into a daily plan you can actually finish — one day at a time.

PDF outline auto-fill

Drop in your course-outline PDF and PlanStudy reads it for you — subjects, topics and dates pulled straight into a plan.

Focus timer with breaks

Study in focus blocks with built-in breaks. Split any session into Learn, Recall and Review so the time actually sticks.

Streaks that keep you going

Tick off a day, keep the streak alive. A small, honest nudge to come back tomorrow — the way good habits are built.

Weekly summaries

Every week PlanStudy recaps what got done, what slipped, and what the next seven days look like — your week, summarized.

Stats you can read

See the numbers behind the effort — study time by day and completion by subject, all in one clean view.

Deadlines and exam radar

Add assignments and exam dates once. PlanStudy works backwards, slotting revision in before each one arrives.

Works with no connection

Campus Wi-Fi drops, data runs out. Your timetable and today's plan stay open on your phone, always.

Phone and laptop

Sketch the week on your phone between lectures, finish the plan on your laptop in the library. Same week, same plan.

Free to use

Every feature here — the timetable, the plans, the timer — is free to use, on every device you own.

Questions

Things you might be wondering.

What is PlanStudy?

PlanStudy is an AI study planner. It turns your subjects, deadlines and class timetable into a day-by-day plan you can follow, on your phone or laptop.

When will it launch?

We are still building. Everyone on the waitlist hears first, by email, as soon as it is ready for you.

How much will it cost?

PlanStudy is free to use.

Do I need an internet connection?

No. PlanStudy keeps working with no connection, so your timetable and plan are always there when you need them.

Does it work on my phone and my laptop?

Yes. PlanStudy is made for both phones and laptops.

What do you do with my email address?

We use it only to tell you when PlanStudy is ready. We will not sell it.
